items.stem: The core unit of data collection in GA4 is the:

options.text: Session, as in the previous Universal Analytics model
options.rationale: GA4 moved away from the session-centric model to events.
Correct: GA4 is built on an event-based model where everything is an event with parameters.
A pageview is just one type of event in GA4, not the core unit.
GA4 does not use the old fixed hit-type structure.

items.explanation: Correct: GA4 is built on an event-based model where everything is an event with parameters.

items.stem: The main reason to write a measurement plan before configuring GA4 is to:

options.text: Collect as much raw data as technically possible
options.rationale: Collecting everything without a plan creates noise, not insight.

options.text: Tie tracking to specific business questions and KPIs
options.rationale: Correct: a measurement plan ensures you track what answers real business questions.
A plan often justifies custom events; it does not forbid them.

options.text: Remove the need for naming conventions
options.rationale: A plan reinforces naming conventions rather than removing them.

items.explanation: Correct: a measurement plan ensures you track what answers real business questions.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about attribution in GA4 are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: Different attribution models can assign conversion credit differently across channels
options.rationale: Correct: the chosen model changes how credit is distributed.

options.text: Last-click attribution can understate the role of earlier touchpoints
options.rationale: Correct: last-click gives all credit to the final interaction, hiding assist value.

options.text: Attribution model choice never affects reported channel performance
options.rationale: Model choice directly changes reported channel credit.

options.text: Only one attribution model exists in GA4
options.rationale: GA4 offers more than one attribution model to compare.

items.explanation: Correct: the chosen model changes how credit is distributed.; Correct: last-click gives all credit to the final interaction, hiding assist value.
